name: Hitomi Katsuya
source:
A fellow voice actor at Nadeshiko Productions.
He's usually a cool and composed guy, but in front of [url=/c41176]Higuchi[/url] he becomes as cowardly as a deer. 
He recently transferred to NadePro from their rival company Star Productions.
He voices characters in many works aimed at girls and has a lot of teenage fans, but his true dream is to voice the hero character in a kids anime.
